description: Header file defining utility structures and functions for generating ninja build commands related to target configuration, including writers for defines, frameworks, weak libraries, include paths, and functions for handling precompiled headers.

classes.name: DefineWriter
classes.description: Utility for writing preprocessor define flags into build commands.

classes.name: FrameworkDirsWriter
classes.description: Utility for writing framework directory flags.

classes.name: WeakLibrariesWriter
classes.description: Utility for writing weak library flags.

classes.name: IncludeWriter
classes.description: Utility for writing include directory flags.

methods.name: WriteOneFlag
methods.description: Function to write a specific build flag based on target and substitution.

methods.name: GetPCHOutputFiles
methods.description: Function to retrieve precompiled header output files for a target.

methods.name: GetGCCPCHOutputExtension
methods.description: Function to get the output extension for GCC precompiled headers.

methods.name: GetWindowsPCHObjectExtension
methods.description: Function to get the object extension for Windows precompiled headers.
